title: How fast does native oxide come back? The surface after HF and "hydrogen termination" [Cleaning Level 3, Lesson 2 Extra]
excerpt: How long does it take for native oxide to come back after it is removed with hydrofluoric acid (HF)? In this extra lesson for Lesson 2 of Cleaning Level 3, learn what a hydrogen-terminated surface looks like and get a sense of how thin native oxide is. You can also review key terms and common misconceptions.
